content.summary: Research findings for intermittent provider timeout/UnknownError failures after sleep/wake

data.original_input: Investigate intermittent provider timeout/UnknownError failures after Mac sleep/wake, focusing on provider timeout/signal merge path around provider.ts lines ~1049-1053 and commits b24f4e3d2, ae62bc8b1, 6d3fc6365.

codebase_findings.evidence: POST /:sessionID/message calls SessionPrompt.prompt and streams JSON response
prompt() creates user message then calls loop(); loop() creates/resumes per-session AbortController
cancel() aborts controller and clears session loop state; /:sessionID/abort route calls it
SessionProcessor uses same AbortSignal and calls LLM.stream(streamInput)
fetch wrapper merges init.signal with AbortSignal.timeout(options.timeout) via AbortSignal.any and disables Bun timeout with timeout:false
DOMException AbortError maps to MessageAbortedError; unrecognized Error objects become NamedError.Unknown
Automatic retry only occurs for retryable APIError; abort/unknown paths do not retry

prior_art.title: fix: timeout option
prior_art.change: Switched timeout from Bun fetch timeout option to AbortSignal.timeout + AbortSignal.any merge with existing signal; forced fetch timeout:false

prior_art.title: fix: timeout param that allows user to disable provider timeout
prior_art.change: Added timeout !== false branch to allow disabling provider timeout while keeping signal merge

prior_art.title: core: refactor provider and model system
prior_art.change: Refactored provider/config typing; timeout schema/docs retained; no functional change in timeout fetch wrapper

prior_art.title: tweak: default to disabling fetch timeout in provider options
prior_art.change: Made fetch wrapper unconditional, always sets timeout:false, and changed init handling to mutable opts object

patterns: Timeout logic is enforced at provider fetch layer, not in LLM/session layer.
Session abort and provider timeout are now both signal-based and merged.
Error mapping has a gap for timeout-shaped errors that are not DOMException AbortError/APICallError.
Config docs claim default 300000 ms timeout, but runtime only applies timeout when provider.options.timeout is present.
Current wrapper mutates init-derived opts.signal, unlike earlier non-mutating implementation in b24/ae.
raw_options: Run a no-code config experiment: timeout=false vs explicit timeout, before/after sleep/wake.
Add targeted telemetry around fetch wrapper (timeout value, signal state, error class/reason).
Normalize TimeoutError/ETIMEDOUT/Abort-like errors in MessageV2.fromError for consistent retryability and UX.
Refactor provider fetch wrapper to avoid mutating init and to use clearable timeout composition.
Validate whether default timeout docs match runtime by instrumenting provider.options.timeout at request time.
Build deterministic repro script with long streaming call + forced sleep/wake window.
